ll mod_pow(ll base, ll exp, ll mod) {
    ll res = 1;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) res = res * base % mod;
        base = base * base % mod;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ll P, K;
    scanf("%lld%lld", &P, &K);
    vector<bool> used(P, false);

            ++components;
            ll curr = i;

                used[curr] = true;

    ll exponent = components;
    if (K == 1) exponent += 1;

    printf("%lld\n", ans);

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
const ll MOD = 1e9 + 7;
bool used[1000000];

void dfs(ll curr, ll K, ll P) {
    if (used[curr]) return;
    used[curr] = true;
    dfs(curr * K % P, K, P);
}

int main() {
    ll P, K;
    char buf[32];
    fgets(buf, 32, stdin);
    char *p = buf;
    P = 0; K = 0;
    while (*p && *p != ' ') P = P * 10 + (*p++ - '0');
    if (*p == ' ') ++p;
    while (*p && *p != '\n') K = K * 10 + (*p++ - '0');
    ll ans = 1;
    if (K == 1) {
        ans = (ans * P) % MOD;
    }
    for (ll i = 1; i < P; ++i) {
        if (!used[i]) {
            dfs(i, K, P);
            ans = (ans * P) % MOD;
        }
    }
    char out[32];
    int len = 0;
    ll tmp = ans;
    if (tmp == 0) out[len++] = '0';
    else {
        while (tmp > 0) {
            out[len++] = '0' + (tmp % 10);
            tmp /= 10;
        }
        reverse(out, out + len);
    }
    out[len++] = '\n';
    fwrite(out, 1, len, stdout);
    return 0;
}
